Dictation broke because every Servex restart killed Whisper, which then took 2–14 s to reload. Whisper now outlives Servex and the next Servex adopts it. After a live Servex restart, the same dictate-and-reload loop ran 85 dictations and 50 page reloads with 0 failures.

- **Evidence:** Servex restarts and Whisper starts match 13 = 13, 11 = 11 and 1 = 1 on Oct 8, 9 and 11. A 10-minute loop on the dev server with files churning had 0 failures, so the dev server was never the problem.
- **Not measured:** I couldn't run the loop across a restart on the old code, because the restart killed the loo
